_note: Where the units web sites live. The docs are a site and a repository of their own (https://github.com/plsdontcallmyfone/units-docs: content, build, tests, deploy) whose canonical origin is always docs_canonical. app_url: the app's own origin, the devnet site until the owner's app domain exists, then that domain; the docs repository keeps its copy of it in its site.json (the app the docs link to and read live figures from), change both together. docs_url: where the app's /docs redirects and in-app docs links go; the temporary docs host until the DNS record of docs.units.gg exists, then https://docs.units.gg. The environment overrides docs_url for one build or one server: UNITS_DOCS_URL (app server, app bundles, deploy kit).
